title: A sphere from two angular parameters
description: Use longitude u and polar angle v to parameterize the unit sphere.
assumptions: x = cos(u)sin(v), y = sin(u)sin(v), z = cos(v).
0 ≤ u ≤ 2π and 0 ≤ v ≤ π, in radians.
The mesh is an approximation to a smooth surface.

diagrams.caption: Every exact parameterized point satisfies x² + y² + z² = 1. Rotate the view to inspect the poles and seam; no built-in parametric-surface identity check is claimed.
